headline: Clinton order on how federal employees get to work, likely about commuting benefits such as help paying for public transit.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with transportation for the federal workforce, meaning how federal employees commute to their jobs. Based on the title alone, it appears to direct federal agencies to take steps related to employee commuting. Such steps may include offering benefits that help workers pay for public transit or vanpools. No official summary was provided, so the exact rules, amounts, and deadlines cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: They may get new or expanded help with commuting costs, such as transit or vanpool benefits.
They may be required to set up or expand commuting programs for their workers.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 21, 2000; specific start dates are not stated in the provided material.
